response.original_title: Dreamflow, la escuela está en peligro
response.overview: In Samne Ghat, a slum settlement on the banks of the Ganges in the holy city of Varanasi, a group of teenagers from the lowest caste runs a community school. Guided by Jesumiel, a young Argentine woman, they train to become teachers for the local children. In a society structured by caste discrimination, the school faces a threat that puts its survival at risk.
